descriptionChirho: To let drop, release, or remit; used especially of the sabbatical year release of debts and letting land lie fallow (Qal and Hifil causative 'grant release').
To throw or hurl a person or thing down forcefully, as in casting someone from a height (Qal active).
To lose one's footing, stumble or slip; used intransitively of warriors or people faltering (Qal intransitive).
To be hurled or cast down; the Niphal passive of the 'throw down' sense, describing persons thrown from a height.
